summary: This resolution supports designating September 2025 as Peace Month and calls on Congress to promote peace at home and abroad.

The bill makes no mention of taxes, tax policy, rates, or revenue measures of any kind.

The text has no bearing on immigration policy, borders, or pathways.

No environmental or climate-related provisions are present.

No educational policy, funding, or reforms are mentioned.
The resolution contains nothing related to drug enforcement or decriminalization.

No trade, tariffs, or globalization provisions exist in the text.
